verdict.rationale: Muse documents connecting your own data (finances, health and fitness, email, calendar) and generating insights and suggestions from it. Examples include flagging forgotten charges, auditing subscriptions, building dashboards to find sleep patterns, and creating workout or meal plans that adjust day by day, with notifications when something needs attention. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how insights are produced and surfaced (current evidence is marketing and app-store copy), independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: It tracks expenses, audits subscriptions, flags charges you forgot about, cancels what you don't need, and helps you hit a savings goal
a dashboard to find patterns in your sleep
It builds a custom workout or meal plan from data you choose to share, tracks calories and nutrition, monitors sleep and wellness, and adjusts your training day by day.
Link your email, calendar, Instagram, Facebook, health and fitness data, and finances.
It monitors, follows up, and sends a notification when something needs your attention
